description.title: Landing Capabilities (CAT 2, CAT 3 SINGLE, CAT 3 DUAL)

descbody.para: When the landing capability of the aircraft is impacted by an inoperative item, the associated MMEL operational procedure provides the maximum landing capability.
The required equipment by certification for CAT 2, CAT 3 SINGLE and CAT 3 DUAL are also listed in the Flight Manual () and the QRH ().
The equipment to be operative to get CAT 2, CAT 3 SINGLE, or CAT 3 DUAL capability displayed on the FMAs are listed in the QRH ().
